EP09:E66 83800-86500 CAMERA: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.

EP09:E76 95000-97200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
EP09:E77 95300-97300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Mocking, Arrogant]: "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."

EP09:E81 101400-101900 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Sharp, Demanding]: "Where?"
EP09:E82 102200-104000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
EP09:E83 102300-103600 THE FORMER GROOM [Cautious]: "No one seems certain."
EP09:E84 104000-106000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
EP09:E85 104200-105900 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Dismissive, Masking Panic]: "Then let it remain a rumor."
EP09:E86 106000-108000 CAMERA: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
EP09:E87 108000-112000 CAMERA: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

EP09:E89 112000-115500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.
